pages.text: $(italic)Dragon-blooded and ancient. Resilient and imposing, the Ryu shrugs off damage and heals from food.$()$(br2)$(bold)Natural Protection$(): $(item)25% damage reduction$().$(br2)$(bold)Slow Fall$(): broken wings give slow fall, not true flight.$(br2)$(bold)Food Healing$(): eating food triggers accelerated healing.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Meat Preference$(): $(warn)non-meat food gives less nourishment.$()$(br2)$(bold)Healing Potions$(): $(warn)only 50% effective.$() Your scaled hide resists potions.$(br2)$(bold)Next: stock cooked meat instead of potions. Your healing runs through your stomach.$()
